verdict.rationale: uv's docs make a quantified speed claim ("10-100x faster than pip") and show timed CLI output ("Resolved 1 package in 6ms / Installed 1 package in 2ms"), but the pack contains no published benchmark suite or methodology behind that number. An independent Plotly benchmark exists and qualifies the claim, finding the speed gain is largely lost when uv is configured to mimic pip; this is a conditional caveat rather than a concrete contradiction. missing for 10: a first-party published benchmark page with methodology and reproducible results, measured comparisons across workloads, and independent benchmarks confirming the headline multiplier.
